storyArt.title: The Valley of Dry Bones
storyArt.alt: Ezekiel holds two wooden sticks together before a gathering in a mist-filled valley.
storyArt.review: Retain recognizable strong nose, curls and graying beard, coherent two-stick grip and limbs. Illustrates 37:16–20 within wider Story, not literal simultaneous bones vision; anonymous crowd stays anonymous. Tiny obscured figures remain uncertain.

storyArt.title: Ezekiel Is Shown the Temple in a Vision
storyArt.alt: Ezekiel listens to a guide holding a measuring reed beside a broad temple gate.
storyArt.review: Retain Ezekiel in back view: comparable curls/build, no new face anchor. Separate measuring guide holds reed coherently. Imagined temple geometry; not exact measured reconstruction. Tiny distant figures not detailed portrait claims.

continuity.traits: Brown complexion, strong nose, dark natural curls, beard with plausible gray in later wife/restoration scenes, lean adult build. Early vision is mostly back/profile; wife/restoration scenes give clearer face. Temple scene is back view, not a new face anchor.
continuity.elapsedTime: 1:2 fifth exile year; 8:1 sixth; 24:1 ninth; 40:1 twenty-fifth (about twenty years after opening). Chapter 37 restoration sequence has no separate exact date assigned here.
continuity.earlierBookPortrayals: No active identifiable Ezekiel portrayal before Ezekiel found in earlier books. Noah, Daniel, Job and David are textual mentions, not newly portrayed. Pharaoh/Tyre ruler/armies receive no portraits. Prior recurring inventory consulted; retain distinct identities for guide and anonymous listeners.
continuity.limits: Hidden faces, hands and feet and tiny crowd/bird anatomy cannot be verified; no visible malformed anatomy or unresolved recognizable identity break found.
